title: Fixture fault record
description: Authoritative per-fault metadata for a seeded fixer fixture (plan WB-2.1). HumanEvalFix-shaped: bug_type, failure_symptoms, operator, difficulty, provenance{origin,generator,seed,engine_version}, validation{f2p[],p2p[],fix}. This record carries the canonical fix, so it MUST live OUTSIDE the materialized fixture tree (fixtures/<name>.FAULT.json beside fixtures/<name>/, never inside it) — the runner copies only the fixture directory into a worker workspace (runner/index.ts), and test/breadth.test.ts proves the record is unreachable from that workspace. The suite case shape (schema/suite.schema.json) is untouched: the record is fixture-side, not a suite field.

bug_type.description: HumanEvalFix bug-type vocabulary (enum copied from the MIT-licensed dataset; no instances vendored).

failure_symptoms.description: Behaviour-only description of what a worker observes; never names the mutated line.

operator.description: Catalog operator id (catalog/operators.ts). A combined hard-tier fault joins its operators with '+', e.g. 'shared-reference-return+logical-swap'.

origin.description: Generation mix source (plan WB-2.4: 60% procedural / 30% LM-injected / 10% diff-replay). 'public-bug-canary' marks a synthetic reproduction of a well-known public bug class seeded into the SEPARATE contamination-canary suite (never part of the headline breadth mix).

generator.description: What produced the fault, e.g. 'catalog:babel:ArithmeticOperator' or 'lane-leader-lm'.

seed.description: Deterministic seed used to pick the node/operator (0 for hand-placed LM faults).

engine_version.description: Engine + version the operator semantics follow, e.g. '@stryker-mutator/instrumenter@10.0.0' or 'ts-morph@28.0.0' or 'lm'.

reference.description: Named public reference the fault reproduces (a bug class, advisory, or documentation page). Behavior only — no third-party code is vendored. Required in practice for origin 'public-bug-canary'.

license.description: License/provenance note for the reference, e.g. 'no code vendored; reference is documentation only'.

f2p.description: Previously-green test titles that flip red on the stored faulted state.

p2p.description: Test titles that must stay green in both states (pass-to-pass).

fix.description: The canonical fix: fixture-relative src/ path -> full fixed file content. The judge test overwrites the faulted files with these contents to prove the fixed state passes. Faults live only in src/, so the map is src/-scoped.

adequacy.description: Single-statement-deletion sanity target (R6 digest §2 P2P adequacy): deleting this exact statement from the FIXED source must make the suite red. Data-driven so the validator needs no heuristic statement picker.

tell_audit.description: Adversarial tell audit (R6 digest §2): a critic saw the faulted-vs-fixed DIFF but not the tests and tried to name the bug.
